safety_verdicts.content: Patient reports shortness of breath while running.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold specifies SOB while running; generated does not mention exertional/running-related SOB.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting that dyspnea occurs with running removes an exertional component that helps gauge severity and functional limitation in an asthma flare. This could slightly reduce urgency of assessment or objective testing (e.g., peak flow) but is unlikely to directly change immediate treatment by itself.
